(Content Security Policy Header Not Set: non-standard 404 or probe responses do not render HTML or execute scripts)
(Cookie Without SameSite Attribute: XSRF-TOKEN uses SameSite=None for local cross-origin API calls; hardened in production)
(CSP style-src unsafe-inline: required by React SPA runtime for dynamic styling; backend API CSP has unsafe-inline removed)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set: backend API endpoints serve JSON data where browser device permissions do not apply)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: CORS headers are dynamically validated against configured origin allowlist)
